dedupe_keys.name: beidou navigation satellite system official site china satellite navigation office satellite maintenance notices interface documents and monitoring

description: The English site of the BeiDou Navigation Satellite System (BDS), run by the China Satellite Navigation Office, is the official source for the system's public notices and documents. Its news section publishes advisory notices on on-orbit upgrade and maintenance operations of named BDS-3 satellites, for example operations on MEO and GEO satellites starting on 18, 19 and 20 April 2026, during which single satellites are taken out of service in turn. Coverage: the global BeiDou constellation. The Systems section has pages for the system description, official documents (interface control documents and performance standards), ephemeris, monitoring and evaluation, and white papers, and links to the CSNO Test and Assessment Research Center. Format and access: HTML notices and downloadable documents; free. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the Systems pages are built with scripts, so the document lists, ephemeris files and monitoring products were not read; notices in the news list were read only in summary. Simulation uses: satellite outage notices and service documents support studies of satellite navigation dependence and of timing and positioning outages in other infrastructure. Related records: the BeiDou science database of iGMAS (data-beidou-science-database-igmas) and DLR GNSS performance monitoring (data-dlr-gnss-performance-monitoring) provide monitoring data.
